subject: ENVIRONMENT
bill.title: Requires DEP to conduct study of short and long term effects of water use by large-scale data centers.

action.description: Reported out of Assembly Committee, 2nd Reading

posted_text:
🏢 NJ A3966 — Big Tech's Water Use Could Change How NJ Uses Its Resources

New Jersey data centers are guzzling water – and this bill wants to find out exactly how. The Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) will launch a study to examine the short- and long-term impacts of water use by large-scale data centers, looking at everything from cooling systems and operational costs to potential strain on public water supplies. The study will consider existing data centers *and* any planned new facilities. ...
